game.title: Galaxy Salvager

plan.title: Galaxy Salvager
plan.concept: Pilot a salvage ship through dangerous deep-space debris fields, collecting salvage cores and energy cells while avoiding mines, plasma barriers, and hostile seeker drones. The game focuses on survival, quick collection routes, and smart use of boosts and shields as the field becomes more hazardous.
features: Collect salvage cores and energy cells
Avoid asteroid mines, plasma barriers, and seeker drones
mechanics: Difficulty ramp with denser obstacle fields
substitutions: Requested space flight movement in all directions -> using dodge_collect free-flight arena movement instead
plan.gameplay_summary: Players steer the salvage ship through drifting debris, weaving between hazards while grabbing salvage cores and energy cells. Power-ups create brief windows to push deeper into the field, survive dense obstacle waves, and chase higher scores.
plan.visual_style_summary: High-contrast sci-fi visuals with glowing salvage pickups, dark starfields, and colorful nebula backdrops. The atmosphere is tense and futuristic, with bright hazard effects and crisp ship trails.
plan.subject: Space survival and collection
plan.learning_objective: Players practice spatial awareness, risk assessment, and quick decision-making while navigating hazards and collecting resources.
plan.controls: Arrow keys or WASD to move, tap/click drag on mobile to steer, spacebar or button to boost
plan.replayability: Randomized hazard layouts and escalating score-chase difficulty encourage repeated runs and mastery.

visual_plan.visual_style_summary: High-contrast sci-fi visuals with glowing salvage pickups, dark starfields, and colorful nebula backdrops. The atmosphere is tense and futuristic, with bright hazard effects and crisp ship trails.

game.request: Galaxy Salvager — a space flight survival collector. Pilot a salvage ship drifting through deep space debris fields, collecting salvage cores and energy cells while dodging asteroid mines, plasma barriers and seeker drones. Shield and boost pickups, nebula and starfield environments, escalating danger, space flight movement in all directions.

spec.title: Galaxy Salvager
spec.description: Pilot the GS-7 Salvage Hauler through ten escalating deep-space debris sectors, collecting salvage cores and energy cells while outrunning asteroid mines, plasma barriers, and seeker drones across visually distinct nebula and starfield environments.
spec.subject: Space Survival & Strategy
spec.learning_objective: Develop spatial reasoning, reaction timing, risk-reward decision-making, and strategic resource management through escalating space-flight survival challenges with increasing hazard complexity.
spec.controls: Desktop: Arrow Keys or WASD to move in all directions; Space to activate Boost. Mobile: Virtual joystick (left thumb) to steer; Boost button (right thumb). Collect glowing gold cores and cyan energy cells. Shield pickups grant temporary invincibility; Boost pickups give a short speed burst to escape dense hazard clusters.

unlockables.label: Nebula Trail FX — cyan exhaust plume
Ion Thruster Skin — gold hull accent
Plasma Wing Upgrade — purple wing glow
Void Reaper Hull — full obsidian black recolor

achievements.label: Perfect Run — complete a stage without taking a single hit
Combo King — reach a 10× combo multiplier in one stage
Core Hoarder — collect 100 total cores across all stages
Ghost Pilot — complete any 3 stages without ever using Boost
Shield Miser — finish a stage with a shield pickup collected but never triggered
Sector Ace — clear all 10 sectors in a single run
Speed Demon — finish Sector 8 while Boost is actively firing at the moment of completion
Survivor — reach Sector 5 without losing any of your 3 starting lives
